C1763.title: Typical Scenarios of Repackaging Attacks: Injecting Ad SDKs and Swapping Payment Recipients
C1763.summary: After obtaining an app's installation package, attackers repackage it with malicious code. Common scenarios include inserting ad SDKs into the app and redistributing it through third-party channels to generate ad revenue, and modifying payment interface parameters to replace the recipient's account with the attacker's, resulting in user fund theft.

references.title: Is Your App Client Really Secure? Full Analysis of Decompilation, Repackaging, and Debugging Attacks
